ARCH-TIED_RUNTIME_DISK_CONFIG.name: On-disk runtime config surfaces
ARCH-TIED_RUNTIME_DISK_CONFIG.decision: Centralize runtime resolution in tools/bootstrap/lib/tied-runtime-config.mjs. Clients read .cursor/mcp.json (then .mcp.json) tied-yaml server entry; store mode reads .tied/store.yaml with store.local.yaml overlay. Install refresh writes store.local.yaml and MCP JSON env via installMcpLayer. MCP tied-layout.ts may implement a subset of layout.mjs store-runtime markers—document intentional gap; full parity deferred.

rationale.why: Single module tested with bootstrap; aligns CLI, MCP stdio child, and agentstream disk resolver.
problems_solved: Undocumented operator reliance on shell exports
IMPL pseudo-code drift from shipped install refresh guards
benefits: Store self-refresh allowSelfInstall composes with layered install

implementation_approach.summary: tied-runtime-config.mjs + mcp layer refresh; no shell path authority for global roots.
details: Intentional subset: MCP layout introspection not required for SC-RDC-*
